answer: The best sybil defense is slow trust: influence equals account age times honest epochs, so fresh identities carry near-zero weight in voting and markets. An attacker flooding the network with fake island accounts gains little, because every new vault entry must age and pass integrity epochs before its ember of reputation grows into real influence. That means simulating years of patient honest behavior per identity, burning compute, fees, and time, while a caught cheat slashes the score. Attacker cost scales with influence, so bulk sybils lose.
